trait.name: Blood Oath Spear Soul
base: Has [Crimson Radiance]. When [Piety] decreases, the points are converted into the same number of stacks of [Killing Intent]. At the start of the action, consumes all NRG and gains 5 stacks of [Killing Intent] per NRG consumed.
While [Piety] is not 0, increases final DMG by 15% and reduces final DMG taken by 15%.

1: Has [Radiant Army Spirit I]. Increases DEF by 10%; 20% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK. [Piety] decreases by 20 at the start of battle and by 10 at the start of the action.
Before attacking, if the character charged or moved 3 or more tiles, gains 2 stacks of [Unyielding Spear] (2 turns). Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
After dealing [Piercing DMG], inflicts 1 stack of [Wound] on the target (2 turns).
2: Has [Radiant Army Spirit I]. Increases DEF by 10%; 20% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK. [Piety] decreases by 20 at the start of battle and by 10 at the start of the action.
Before attacking, if the character charged or moved 3 or more tiles, gains 2 stacks of [Unyielding Spear] (2 turns). Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
After dealing [Piercing DMG], inflicts 1 stack of [Wound] on the target (2 turns). When attacking a target with [Wound], gains 5% [Life Steal].
3: Has [Radiant Army Spirit I]. Increases DEF by 20%; 30% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK. [Piety] decreases by 40 at the start of battle and by 10 at the start of the action.
Before attacking, if the character charged or moved 3 or more tiles, gains 3 stacks of [Unyielding Spear] (2 turns). Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
After dealing [Piercing DMG], inflicts 2 stacks of [Wound] on the target (2 turns). When attacking a target with [Wound], gains 5% [Life Steal].
4: Has [Radiant Army Spirit I]. Increases DEF by 20%; 30% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK. [Piety] decreases by 40 at the start of battle and by 10 at the start of the action.
Before attacking, if the character charged or moved 3 or more tiles, gains 3 stacks of [Unyielding Spear] (2 turns). Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
After dealing [Piercing DMG], inflicts 2 stacks of [Wound] on the target (2 turns). When attacking a target with [Wound], gains 10% [Life Steal].
5: Has [Radiant Army Spirit II]. Increases DEF by 30%; 40% of P.DEF is added to P.ATK. [Piety] decreases by 40 at the start of battle and by 20 at the start of the action.
Before attacking, if the character charged or moved 3 or more tiles, gains 5 stacks of [Unyielding Spear] (2 turns). Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.
After dealing [Piercing DMG], inflicts 2 stacks of [Wound] on the target (2 turns). When attacking a target with [Wound], gains 10% [Life Steal].

22904.name: Spear Soul - Darkstar Piercing Formation
desc: (Piercing DMG) [Instant] Selects any tile in a cross within 6 tiles of the character and performs a [Precise Charge] (can pass through; collision DMG taken by the character is reduced by 100%), dealing 50% DMG to enemies on the path and on both sides, inflicting 2 stacks of [Wound] (2 turns) and knocking them back 1 tile (in the charge direction). After attacking, gains 20 stacks of [Killing Intent].
[Auxiliary Passive]: After a [Charge], Movement increases by 2 tiles (until the end of the action), and gains [▲ATK II] and [▲Piercing DMG II] for 2 turns.

22987.name: Valiant Breakthrough
desc: (Piercing DMG) Selects any [Empty tile] in a cross within 3 tiles of the character, charges there (ignoring obstacles) and deals 120% [AoE DMG] to enemies in a 3×3 area in the target direction.
After attacking, gains [▲P.DEF III] and [▲M.DEF III] for 2 turns.

23543.name: Sealing Attack
desc: (Basic Attack) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 80% of P.ATK. Before attacking an [Injured] enemy, inflicts [⊘Passive Skills] for 2 turns.

22929.name: Blood Spear Thrust
desc: (Basic Attack) Selects a tile and deals [Piercing AoE DMG] equal to 60% of P.ATK to all enemies within 3 tiles straight ahead, and gains 10 stacks of [Killing Intent].

[Auxiliary Passive]: After attacking with a [Basic Attack] or a non-Instant [Extra Skill], reduces the cooldown of the character's active [Class Skills] by 1 turn. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round.

22942.name: Unwavering Spearpoint
desc: (Passive) Increases max HP by 40%. Before being attacked, inflicts [Taunted], [▼ATK II] and [▼DMG II] on the attacker for 2 turns. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.
When attacked by a target affected by [Control], reduces DMG taken by 30%.
Has [Resolve]: when triggered, recovers 70% HP. Cooldown: 4 turns.

22925.name: Blood Oath Chains
desc: (Decision) Selects to use [Blood Oath - Hunt] or [Blood Oath - Guard]; using either skill puts both on cooldown.
[Auxiliary Passive]: At the end of a charge, teleports targets with a [Blood Oath] effect next to the character and removes that effect.

22964.name: Imposing Might
desc: (Reaction) Increases max HP by 20%. When attacked by an enemy within 2 tiles of the character, reduces DMG taken by 30%.

When attacked by an enemy, if the attacker's total ATK is less than 250% of the character's total DEF, deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 40% of the character's P.ATK to the attacker. Can be triggered up to 2 times per round.

22935.name: Transgressors Shall Fall
desc: (Passive) When attacked, if there are enemies in the 3×4 area in the attacker's direction, performs a [Daunting Counter], dealing Piercing AoE DMG equal to 60% of P.ATK to enemies in the area; before countering, inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II] on the targets for 2 turns. Can be triggered up to 1 time per round (extra triggers by consuming [Counter Fervor]). When equipped with [Unwavering Spearpoint], this skill's ATK increases by 35%.
After actively attacking, gains [DMG Reduction II] (2 turns) and inflicts [Taunted] on the target for 1 turn (up to 2 targets if several are hit).
For each [Specific Defensive Buff] the character has, DEF increases by an additional 2%, up to 30%.

22921.name: Spear Soul - Lone Rider Against Thousands
desc: (Piercing DMG) Deals [Piercing DMG] equal to 100% of P.ATK to all enemies within 3 tiles of the character. Before attacking, consumes [Killing Intent]: every 10 stacks consumed increase the DMG multiplier by 10% (up to 100 stacks), and inflicts [Piercing Vulnerable II], [⊘Passive Skills] and [⊘Reaction Skills] for 2 turns.
[Auxiliary Passive]: After actively attacking with a non-Instant skill, if this skill is not on cooldown, it is cast automatically; the character then suffers [Lone Rider - Exhausted] (2 turns).

4168.name: Furious Roar
desc: (Passive) Before being attacked, dispels 1 [Buff] from the attacker and inflicts [▼ATK I] on them for 2 turns.

d: When [Piety] would increase, it decreases by the same amount instead. Not affected by negative [Piety] effects; gains the positive [Piety] effects instead.
Increases the effect of some skills. "With blood forged into a spear, I vow to strike down sin!"
Leader's Aura, Level 1: all "Discipline" allies in battle gain 10% ATK and 20% DEF. For every 20% increase of total DEF, DMG and Piercing DMG increase by 5%, up to 10%.
Total DEF increase = (current total DEF - base total DEF) / base total DEF.
Leader's Aura, Level 2: all "Discipline" allies in battle gain 10% ATK and 20% DEF. For every 20% increase of total DEF, DMG and Piercing DMG increase by 10%, up to 20%.
Total DEF increase = (current total DEF - base total DEF) / base total DEF.
DEF attribute buff: each stack increases DEF by 3%. Each stack has its own duration.
When charging, can only select positions within the skill's height difference.
Skills gained during battle, such as skills granted by traits, by interactive objects in the scene, team skills, etc.

Disruption. When leaving the 2-tile range of the caster, each tile costs 1 extra Movement. When [Leonide SP] charges, if in an effective position, is teleported next to her destination. Removed after triggering.
Mark. When [Leonide SP] charges, if in an effective position, is teleported next to the destination. Removed after triggering.
Includes [Blood Oath - Hunt] and [Blood Oath - Guard].
Grants extra counterattack triggers to the skill [Transgressors Shall Fall]; consumed when triggered, up to 3 stacks.
At the end of the action, consumes [Killing Intent] in multiples of 20: every 20 stacks consumed grant 1 stack of [Counter Fervor] (up to the stack limit).
Includes all levels of defensive buffs, such as the [▲P.DEF], [▲M.DEF] and [DMG Reduction] series, plus [Defensive Ward] and [Unyielding Spear].
While active, [Spear Soul - Lone Rider Against Thousands] cannot be triggered automatically.
